runs.edit_timing_semantics: Actual filesystem change within operation interval;timestamp is first observed upper bound,not model intent
runs.applicable_patch_semantics: First observed successful native application of returned patch;earlier checkpoints not independently applied
runs.repetition_caveat: Proxy fixes command+production hashes;test/environment identity and diagnostic purpose require manual review
runs.strict_repeat_definition: Exact assertion command+observed production hashes+observed test/script edit epoch; conservative proxy, not complete filesystem equivalence.

context_guard_events.correctness_limit: Only inferred from final native positive plus no subsequent observed production mutation; not a direct verification at guard time.
